caption: The drawing depicts a single metal object resembling an ornamental door handle or hinge, centered on a plain, beige background. The object consists of three main parts: an upper plate shaped like an arrowhead with scalloped sides and three round holes, a rounded central handle with horizontal grooves, and a lower plate shaped like an inverted heart with six round holes. The entire object appears to be made of a rusted brown or bronze-colored metal, with visible marks of aging and slight tarnishing. The object is depicted with precise lines and shaded to indicate depth and dimension. Near the bottom right edge of the drawing, there is small handwritten text that appears to be the artist's name and a reference number.
title: Suffolk Latch
